query:
SELECT 
  s.id as search_id,
  SUBSTRING(s.offeringName, 1, 40) as campaign,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_research,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.salesApproachData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.briefData IS NOT NULL AND c.salesApproachData IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_approach
FROM searches s
JOIN companies c ON c.searchId = s.id
GROUP BY s.id
HAVING has_research > 0
ORDER BY s.id DESC
LIMIT 10;
